chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Abī al-Safātij, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Concerning the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
“And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell.”
He عليه السلام said: “His recompense is Hell, if He recompenses him.”

key_terms.جَازَاهُ: He recompensed him; meaning Allah requited him for the act
key_terms.جَزَاؤُهُ: his recompense; the due return or punishment for the act
key_terms.جَهَنَّمُ: Hell; the Fire mentioned as punishment
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: a believer; the protected faithful person mentioned in the verse
key_terms.مُتَعَمِّدًا: intentionally; done deliberately and with intent

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explain the verse about killing a believer intentionally?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a commentary on the verse concerning the intentional killing of a believer. Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام explains that Hell is his recompense if Allah, Mighty and Majestic, chooses to requite him, indicating the gravity of the crime while affirming divine discretion in punishment.
